adversaries_retained: joint pairs with zero singleton effect
equal capture table with opposite loss

bounds_and_proof.a_witness_above_the_floor: is an upper bound only and does not by itself prove a ratio above one
bounds_and_proof.arithmetic_floor: ceil( (decision - tolerance) / max_i (a+b) * weight_i ), a proved lower bound
bounds_and_proof.exact_minimum: claimed only when a witness meets the floor, or when all smaller admissible sets are ruled out within budget
bounds_and_proof.no_pruning: zero singleton effect annotations are retained, because a joint deletion can change the optimum through reassignment
bounds_and_proof.witness: an exhibited deleting set, an upper bound

budgets.amendment: any budget change is recorded as a dated amendment to this protocol before the remaining cases run
budgets.pilot: set after the pilot measures parsing, preparation, search, checking, memory and storage

census.frames_with_zero_qualifying_annotations: retained as declared empty, not dropped. Empty, missing and failed inputs are three distinct states
census.source: the nuScenes validation split as verified by this lane

comparison.additions: the second detector's qualifying rows that survive suppression against the base
comparison.base: the first detector of the ordered pair, fully retained after qualification
comparison.form: base plus suppressed additions, not model replacement
comparison.pairs: all 20 ordered pairs among the five qualified submissions

decision_unit.count: 150 scenes times 20 ordered pairs, up to 3000 declared units before input failures
decision_unit.explicitly_not: 3000 independent experiments. Units share scenes, objects and detectors. Frames inside a scene are correlated and the 20 ordered pairs reuse the same five submissions
decision_unit.justification: a scene is the coarsest unit over which the declared loss is naturally weighted and the finest unit that does not treat consecutive frames of one drive as separate comparisons
decision_unit.unit: one scene cohort under one ordered detector pair
decision_unit.weights: equal frame weights within each scene cohort

edit_family.correction_unit: one frame annotation record, not a tracked object group
edit_family.primary: delete exactly one frame annotation record
edit_family.recomputation: both matchings recomputed in full; competition and reassignment preserved
edit_family.secondary_families: insertions are a separately declared family and are never pooled into the same breakdown number
edit_family.status: hypothetical perturbations, not discovered label errors

exposure_record.earlier_protocols_do_not_cover_this: the label dependence preregistrations 0.1.0 through 0.3.0 preregister the two case studies only
exposure_record.honesty_note: this is lane reported exposure. No independent audit of what this lane has seen exists, and readers should treat it as good faith rather than proof
exposure_record.prior_cases: two annotation conditional cases on 16 frames from two scenes are already computed and published by this lane. Those frames are exposed and their outcomes are known here
exposure_record.this_study: no outcome of any comparison declared below has been computed by this lane. The pilot selection rule is published here before the pilot runs

inclusion_and_rules.class_map: the ten nuScenes detection classes; unmapped categories are excluded and counted
inclusion_and_rules.matching: maximum same class one to one, strict distance < 2 m
inclusion_and_rules.population_warning: the 134565 row class dependent cache is NOT the population here. Reference membership is derived from the qualified original tables and ego poses under the common 50 m rule
inclusion_and_rules.range: common nominal XY <= 50 m, derived from the original tables and poses
inclusion_and_rules.suppression: same class, strict distance < 2 m, against the retained base and against earlier retained additions, in a bound published order
inclusion_and_rules.suppression_order: ascending original source row index within the anchor, recorded per case

no_favourable_outcome_is_a_deliverable: a constant ratio, a ratio that adds nothing beyond margin and edit count, or a census dominated by unresolved cases are all acceptable results and will be reported as found

pilot.exposure: pilot units are recorded separately from the remaining census
pilot.independent_check: each pilot unit is recomputed by a separate ordinary rematching implementation that shares no matcher with the producer
pilot.rule: order the 150 scene tokens ascending as strings; take scenes at index 0, 30, 60, 90 and 120. Order the 20 ordered pairs alphabetically by base then addition; take pairs at index 0, 5, 10 and 15. The pilot is the 20 resulting units

question: over a declared census of engineering comparisons, how many hypothetical single annotation deletions are needed to remove support under the declared loss and tolerance, how often is that minimum equal to its proved arithmetic floor, how often above it, and how often unresolved

explicitly_not_claimed: an annotation error rate or probability
that a floor ratio of one means a small physical perturbation
industry deployment practice, human savings, customer demand or novelty
any statement about a wider population without an explicit sampling and scene dependence model
official mAP or NDS: this is the Engine additive loss
reporting.if_unresolved_cases_prevent_a_frequency: bounds on the frequency with their denominator
reporting.required_form: among N declared annotation conditional decisions under loss L and edit family F, X were certified at their arithmetic floor, Y above it, and Z remained unresolved
